comment: Recorded from managed by ServiceControlRuntimeTests.NativeLifecycleReconcileVectors; regenerate with OPENBLADE_REGENERATE_NATIVE_PROFILE_VECTORS. profiles is the saved performance the runtime starts from: the plugged-in and battery power profiles and the Game rule's plugged-in override, with Game reported and applied on AC. Each transition row runs in order on that runtime: submitted is whether any device setter was submitted, performance the confirmed preset after it, desired the desired preset and source its source. leaseExpired is ExpireApplicationContextAsync after the 15 s lease; gameReported reports Game again. powerUnchanged, powerToBattery and powerToPluggedIn are HandlePowerSourceChangedAsync with the gate clear. resumeUnchangedAfterDeferral reports Other.exe with the LowPowerGate entered, exits it, and runs HandlePowerSourceChangedAsync on the unchanged source. It models only that part of resume processing: not the rest of ProcessNativeAsync (lighting invalidation and restore, resume validation) or the later convergence. powerToBatteryWithController runs HandlePowerSourceChangedAsync to battery while Razer Synapse's engine is a potential controller; controllerClosedPowerUnchanged clears it and runs HandlePowerSourceChangedAsync on the unchanged source, as a later notice would. userActivatedOnBattery and sameUserReactivated run on a second runtime, initialized on battery with the same profiles and no profile applied: ActivateUserAsync for a user whose saved profiles are those, as its first admitted request runs it, then again for the same user. Every row also records fans, the confirmed fan mode, and externalChanges, the published external changes in DeviceSubsystem order. The drift groups below each run on their own runtime with Game reported and applied on AC. performanceDriftObserved sets Silent outside OpenBlade and observes it; powerToBatteryWithPerformanceDrift, powerToPluggedInWithPerformanceDrift, leaseExpiredWithPerformanceDrift and gameReportedWithPerformanceDrift then run those triggers over it. otherReportedWithOwnPreset reports Other.exe while firmware holds OpenBlade's own Game preset. powerToBatteryWithManualFanDrift sets Fixed fans outside OpenBlade before the change to battery, and powerToPluggedInAfterFansReturnedToAutomatic returns them to Automatic before the change back; powerToBatteryWithStopFanDrift sets Stop instead. powerToBatteryHyperBoostActive and powerToBatteryHyperBoostUnknown report HyperBoost active or unknown before the change to battery. resumePowerToBatteryUnsettled enters and leaves low power, begins resume validation and changes to battery while firmware reports Battery Balanced; resumeSettledWithinWindow then observes Battery Saver inside the observation window. performanceDriftObservedBeforeActivation runs on a battery runtime with no profile applied that observed Battery Saver and then observes Silent; userActivatedWithPerformanceDrift then runs ActivateUserAsync.
